# ◆ MINOS

native dj software for macos (0.x, beta). 4 decks, internal or external mixer, own browser, tags, smartlists, analysis, audio edit, recording, fx and plugin host. The sections below are the app's feature, settings and library docs.

## ◆ STATUS

- 0.x: things still change.
- the collection today is the nml collection. The newest `collection.nml` in the library folder is loaded at start. Other collections open with the open-file command.
- write-back to the nml collection is opt-in and off by default. With it on, changes are written in one pass about 1.5 s after the last apply, after a backup. Only the edited entries change. The write is checked and replaces the file atomically. It does not run while the library app is running.
- write-back maps: metadata to entry attributes; own analysis to tempo, loudness, key and the first grid marker; hot cues 1-8 to cue entries; hand grid to tempo and the first grid marker; renamed files to the location; cut copies and tool loops to new entries; preparation and history to playlists in the `MINOS-741` folder; own playlists to the `MINOS-741` folder.
- changes that stay in MINOS-741 only: trim (cut in / out), active loops, undo.
- conflict: when an entry changed both in MINOS and in the file, the file wins for the whole entry. MINOS keeps its open changes in conflict files in the data folder.
- target: library data moves into `collection.741` through `mnemo-agent`. See format.md for the record types MINOS will use (track, cue, grid, edit, cut, playlist, item, history, played, setting). Until a release ships this, the data folder below is the source of truth.

## ◆ FIRST START

1. close other apps that use the controller (the controller talks to one app at a time)
2. start MINOS. It loads the newest `collection.nml` in the library folder. Other collections: open-file command.
3. settings, audio: pick the output device and the mode. Internal = mixer in the app, master on one pair. External = each deck on its own pair of the desk.
4. settings, controller: check which controller drives which decks. The side is saved per device serial number.
5. load a track: double click (focused deck, 1-4 keys), right click (deck A-D), or the load button on the controller.

Nothing is analysed on start. Tracks without an analysis play, but have no grid, so they do not sync. Right click, then Analyse, computes tempo, grid, key and loudness.

## ◆ FILES AND WHERE DATA LIVES (today)

| what | where |
|---|---|
| collection (read; write only on request) | newest `collection.nml` in the library folder |
| collection backups (write-back on) | `Backup MINOS-741` next to `collection.nml` |
| track metadata edits | `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/metadata.json` |
| settings | user defaults, key `prefs.v1` |
| session (decks, fx, clock, browser) | `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/session.json` |
| hot cue, grid and cut edits | `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/edits.json` |
| cut files | `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/cuts.json` (files next to their originals) |
| browser previews | `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/overviews/overviews.bin` |
| own analysis (tempo, grid, key, loudness) | `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/analysis.json` |
| history | `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/History` |
| preparation archive | `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/Preparation` |
| cover thumbnails (cache, safe to delete) | `~/Library/Caches/MINOS-741/artwork` |
| set recordings and tracklists | `~/Music/MINOS-741/Recordings` (setting) |

Backup = copy the `MINOS-741` folder.

## ◆ RECORDING (summary)

- one click on the record control starts and stops a set recording. Source: internal master, or the desk input in external mode.
- files: lossless m4a, wav or aiff at 24 bit, named by date and time. A tracklist (`.txt`) and a cue sheet (`.cue`) are written next to the file, from the play history.
- the file is closed cleanly on quit, device loss or sleep. A device coming back does not resume the recording.


# FEATURES

everything MINOS does today (beta). details -> MANUAL.

## ◆ DECKS

* 4 decks (A-D), show 1, 2 or 4; hidden decks keep playing
* classic deck set: play, CUE (hold = preview), CUP, reverse, undo
* FLUX: loops, jumps and reverse run in the background, release -> back where the track is
* DBL: instant double of the neighbour deck, same position, plays in sync, no reload
* KEY: keylock, tempo changes keep the pitch; key shift -12 to +12 semitones
* KEY SYNC: shifts the key to fit the master, at most ±6 semitones
* tempo fader with ±6 / 8 / 10 / 16 / 50 / 100 % range, double click = 0
* load lock: a playing deck takes no track (⌥ or shift forces it)
* track end warning, remaining time counts to the cut end
* cover art and tags in the deck header
* right click on a deck -> track menu (edit, show in browser, preview, rating, analyse)
* undo / redo for deck edits (⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z), up to 100 steps
-> MANUAL 04

## ◆ LOOPS + HOTCUES + BEATJUMP

* 8 hotcues per track: click = jump or set, ⌥-click = delete
* hotcues come from the collection, your edits are saved in an own file
* auto loop 1/32 to 32 beats, loop IN / OUT, RE (reloop), LOOP on / off
* active loop: engages when the playhead reaches it, no jump, per track saved
* auto loop on load (4-32 bars, off by default): marked AUTO, not active
* SNAP locks cues and loop points to the beat; loop snap uses stored loops and 4-bar boundaries
* QUANT keeps the beat phase on jumps
* beatjump 1/4 to 64 beats; inside a loop it moves the loop along
* ROLL beat fx: repeats the last length, the deck keeps running underneath
* controller: sync held + hotcue 3 / 4 = one beat back / forward
-> MANUAL 04

## ◆ SYNC / CLOCK / LINK

* SYNC: deck follows the master tempo and phase; sync modes dynamic, fixed, tempo only
* SEMI: a newly loaded track takes the master tempo, no phase lock
* MASTER: the clock or any deck can be the tempo master; AUTO picks a playing deck
* tap tempo, tempo field, metronome on its own output pair
* LINK: network tempo sync with other apps; minos can lead tempo and bar
* link offset (±50 ms) for a constant shift; link diagnosis via right click
* code readout per deck: bar in phrase against the master bar counter
* bar counter, phrase line and beat readout in the top bar
-> MANUAL 06

## ◆ WAVEFORM + GRID

* 3-band blend waveform (bass red, mids green, highs blue), 6-band spectrum or mono
* blend presets A-K and 741 palettes, own presets, changed live
* sharp at any zoom, 1 to 16 seconds per side
* drag to scrub; grab like a record (vinyl or jog)
* overview under each deck, click to jump
* beatgrid with bar numbers, phrase lines (16 to 128 beats), markers every 8 / 16 / 32 bars
* other decks shown on the waveform, purple when in phase
* grid tools: move ±10 / 1 ms, bpm ±0.01, ÷2 ×2, TAP, SET, RESET
* grid anchor ±1 bar or beat; phrase anchor suggestion on load (off / suggest / automatic)
* daw bridge: takes the grid of a clip playing in your daw
-> MANUAL 05

## ◆ MIXER + AUDIO

* internal mixer: gain, auto-gain, 3-band eq with kill, one-knob filter, fader, crossfader + curve
* external mixer mode: every deck on its own usb pair (tested with mixer)
* auto-mix (internal mixer): picks the next track by key, tempo and tag match
* auto-mix transitions on phrase boundaries with bass swap and filter sweep, 8 / 16 / 32 bars
* level meters per deck and master; headroom per mixer mode
* no limiter on purpose, hard clip as the last stage
* preview on its own output pair, never on the system default output
* buffer test (⌘,) finds the smallest buffer size that runs safely on your device
* decks can render in parallel, one thread per deck, switchable while playing
* device unplugged -> decks keep state, output reopens when the device is back
-> MANUAL 07

## ◆ FX + PLUGINS

* 2 or 4 fx units, each a rack of up to 6 insert slots in series
* 7 built-in effects: filter, delay, reverb, gater, roll, flanger, phaser
* reverb: 2 types, freeze (FRZ), send mode for big washes
* beat fx grid follows the master clock
* audio unit (v2, v3) and vst3 plugins in any slot
* audio units run isolated by default: a plugin crash does not stop the audio
* vst3 runs inside the app: a crashing vst3 ends minos
* quick controls: D/W, 3 knobs and 3 buttons per unit, mappable to any parameter
* templates and racks: save and load whole fx setups
* master bus fx on the sum (internal mixer only)
* plugin manager: enable, validate, block / unblock, own plugin folders, install from file
-> MANUAL 08

## ◆ BROWSER

* two panes side by side or stacked, each with own source, search, sort, filters
* sources: collection, playlists, smartlists, running tracks, history, preparation, music folders, explorer
* favorites bar: 6 slots per pane, each a source or a filter
* sort by up to three columns; columns movable, hideable, saved
* two-line rows: title, artist, comment, tags, label; detail bar below the list
* preview: mini overview of each track in its row, with hotcues and loops
* search: artist, title, comments, label, genre, album, key; accents ignored
* played marks, hide played tracks, reset played state (⌥⌘P)
* inline edit and edit window for metadata, several tracks at once
* analyse from the menu: tempo, grid, key, loudness
* drag tracks onto decks, preparation, playlists and folders
-> MANUAL 09

## ◆ TAGS + SMARTLISTS + MATCHING

* tags in comment 2, separator configurable; tags travel with the collection
* click a tag = filter, ⌥-click = exclude; several tags = all must match
* tag groups: a single capital letter starts a group (K kick, B bass, H hats)
* role words (BASIS, SYNTH, DRUMS, VOLL, ATMO) filter by role
* group colors come from the waveform colors; TAGS menu shows one column per group
* smartlists: rule editor on artist, bpm, key, tags, dates, plays, loudness and more
* smartlists: all / any rules, sort + limit, live hit count
* ◆ PASST: only tracks that fit the master key and tempo (±4 %)
* match column: pitch in % needed to reach the master tempo; harmony sort
* key colors on the open key wheel: same, ±1, relative, clash
* match reference: audible key of the master, or fixed decks (several possible)
-> MANUAL 10 · MANUAL 09

## ◆ LIBRARY + FILES

* reads the nml collection; writes only when you turn write-back on, with a backup first
* write-back: edits, hotcues, grids and analysis go into the collection, one entry at a time
* write-back waits while the library software is running
* default: collection untouched, all edits in the MINOS-741 folder
* collection check (read only): missing, broken, empty, duplicate and twin files
* duplicate merge: keeps the best entry, merges tags, cues and rating
* music folders: browse folders on disk; files outside the collection load too
* explorer: find folders and audio files on all drives, incl. usb sticks
* cloud folders: online-only status, download on request
* missing tracks: tree entry lists them, can be sent as a playlist to TIDAL
* playlists: own folders, playlists, smartlists; drag to reorder; undo
* export: nml collection, m3u or a folder with the audio files
* decoded track cache, 1-64 GB (default 8)
* backup = copy the MINOS-741 folder
-> MANUAL 13 · MANUAL 09

## ◆ AUDIO EDIT + PREPARE

* cut audio: mark a range on the beat, save as new file, original never changed
* cut IN / OUT: play only part of a file, no new file
* edit list per track: remove, keep, duplicate, mute, move segments, reverse
* RENDER: edit list -> new file with metadata, grid and cues mapped
* tool loops: exactly 2 / 4 / 8 / 16 beats as own file, seamless loop
* prepare row: grid, cut, A-B-A, gain (AMP / NORM to -0.3 dBFS), join, split, render
* join two tracks on the grid, tempo matched within ±0.5 %
* audio-edit mode: work list of new tracks with suggestions and done marks
* export: wav, aiff, lossless m4a, aac 128-320 kbit/s; bit depth; 44.1-96 kHz; dither
* no mp3 export, no mp3 encoder on this system
-> MANUAL 05 · MANUAL 09

## ◆ ANALYSIS

* own analysis: bpm, grid, key, loudness, in the background
* bpm range one octave, default 100-200
* key profiles learned from your collection (up to 300 tracks)
* loudness drives auto gain: the louder file plays at the same level
* analysis only writes into the collection when write-back is on
* rip check: finds silence, foreign starts and ends, loops at file edges
* rip check suggests cut points; it never cuts by itself
* grid suspects are flagged; phrase anchor is checked on load
-> MANUAL 09

## ◆ RECORDING + HISTORY

* ● REC in the top bar: one click starts and stops the set recording
* source: internal master, or the desk input in external mode
* files: lossless m4a, wav or aiff at 24 bit
* tracklist (.txt) and cue sheet (.cue) written next to the recording
* history: a track counts as played after 30 s audible
* history saved per session, archive browsable in the tree
* preparation: list for the next set, archived on start
-> MANUAL 16 · MANUAL 11

## ◆ CONTROLLERS + KEYS

* controller in native hid mode, up to two units (left: decks A / C, right: B / D)
* side saved per device serial number; a side change swaps both units at once
* startup show on connect: LED sequence of about 9 s, any input stops it
* pads: hotcues 1-4, shift = delete; FLUX tap switches the pad layer to hotcues 5-8
* loop encoder: turn = loop size, push = loop on / off, shift = beatjump
* browse encoder: selection, push = big browser, shift + push = preview
* fx knobs and buttons per side; touch strip = pitch bend (shift = seek)
* 7-segment displays show the loop size of each side
* every keyboard action can be mapped (⌘, -> KEYBOARD)
* other controllers and midi: not supported yet (see planned)
-> MANUAL 12 · controllers

## ◆ TWO MACS

* two macs as one session: they find each other on the network, no setup
* each mac picks its own decks (at most 2) and its own audio interface
* one mac writes to the collection; writing can be handed over
* played marks are shared both ways
* link follows one leading mac; the other follows its tempo and beat
* LIVE keeps the display and the mac awake

## ◆ VIEW + SETTINGS

* view profiles: named layouts (decks, mixer, fx, browser), switch by key
* zoom like a web browser (⌘+ / ⌘- / ⌘0), 50-200 %
* top bar scales 60-130 %; fullscreen hides the toolbar
* compact decks (⌥⌘K): pitch fader, hotcues and grid tools off
* status bar: messages and background jobs; meters for DSP, latency, dropouts, RAM, CPU
* settings (⌘,) with search (⌘F); german and english UI
* help mode: ? in the top bar, rest the mouse on a control for a short explanation
* data folder MINOS-741 next to the collection: settings, session, analyses, edits
-> MANUAL 03

## ◆ STABILITY

* audio and sync run apart from the ui: a hanging ui does not stop the sound
* ui can hang or restart; the set keeps playing
* audio device gone -> decks keep state; output reopens by itself when it is back
* track files decode in a separate process: a hanging cloud file only blocks its helper
* track without data after 4 s is cancelled (setting 2-15 s); other decks stay untouched
* sleep / wake: output reopens, playing decks keep playing, controllers reconnect
* a stuck parallel worker is skipped; the core falls back to serial
* bad audio blocks are dropped, the deck resets and fades back in
-> MANUAL 14

# SETTINGS

everything under ⌘, saved as json in the user defaults (`prefs.v1`).

## ◆ SEARCH

* field on top of the sidebar, ⌘F focuses it, esc clears. typing shows a result list instead of the page: section · group, name, hint excerpt, matches purple
* case and accents ignored, german + english (english from `Localization/en.lproj`), several words = all must match. rank: name > keyword > section > hint, word start > part of a word. synonyms: `SettingsSearch.synonyms`
* click / enter -> section, scroll to the row, purple for 1.5 s. ↑ / ↓ selects. the search stays until cleared or a section is clicked
* index: `SettingsIndex` (section, group, anchor id, label key, hint key, keywords, `alt` = row shown instead while the row is hidden). one entry per key action (KEYBOARD) and per controller block field
* every row carries `.settingsAnchor("<id>")`. unit test: each index anchor exactly once in `Sources/MixApp`, each anchor in the index, every label / section / hint key has an english string. self test line: entries, time per 3-letter search (< 2 ms). ui test `einstellungen-suche`
* new row = `.settingsAnchor` on the row + entry in `SettingsIndex` + english string

## ◆ LAYOUT

* window resizable, min 720 × 520, default 820 × 640
* sidebar left, general -> special: AUDIO · DISPLAY · DECKS · MIXER & FX · PLUGINS · BROWSER · TAGS · CLOUD · KEYBOARD · CONTROLLER, active section with red bar
* own order: drag a sidebar entry onto another (lands above it) or below the last one. right click -> `Standard-Reihenfolge` = default. `ui.settingsTabOrder` (title keys, empty = default; a new section appears after its default predecessor)
* page right, scrolls: `◆ SECTION` heading with hairline, rows with fixed label column left, control right. sections within a page also general -> special
* toggles as squares (red = on), sliders with value + unit (s, ms, pt), hints in small mono
* controller: one block per unit (side, left / right deck, browser pane, fx unit, blink, startup show)
* new section = one line in `SettingsView.tabs`
* sections with more than 40 rows are built lazily (tag colors, plugin list), all others completely, so every anchor exists for the search jump

## ◆ AUDIO

* output device (the system default or any device, saved by uid), channels
* sample rate (what the device offers, applies to the device right away, inside minos from the next start) and buffer size
* reconnect -> restarts the output, also via ↻ in the status bar
* mixer mode: internal (mixer in the app) or external (mixing desk)
* internal: which pair the master goes to
* external: one pair per deck, default a 1/2 · b 3/4 · c 5/6 · d 7/8
* preview: channel pair of the browser preview (automatic: external -> first free pair after the decks, none free -> off; internal -> main output · any pair · off), preview volume -> manual · preview output
* loading & cache: decoding in the file service (own process) or in the app. notice after (no audio data, 2-15 s, default 4), cancel loading after (15-300 s, default 60, file service only), decoded track cache (1-64 gb, default 8) + used size -> architecture · file service
* recording: source (`record.source`: automatic -> external = input from the desk, internal = internal master; input; master), input device (`record.inputUID`, empty = output device), input pair (`record.inputFirstChannel`, 0 = 1/2), show input level without recording (`record.showInputLevel`, off), format (`record.format`: apple lossless 24 bit / wav 24 bit / aiff 24 bit), folder (`record.folder`, empty = `~/Music/MINOS-741/Recordings`) -> manual · recording
* audio core: decks in parallel (deck A on the audio thread, B-D on real-time workers in the device workgroup, same output; default off, for the load test) -> manual · audio core

## ◆ DISPLAY

* language: system / english / german (after restart)
* zoom of the main window: 50-200 %, also ⌘+ / ⌘− / ⌘0 -> manual
* layout: decks shown 1 / 2 / 4 (`ui.deckCount`, older `showFourDecks` is read once), gap between decks 0-12 pt (0 = waveforms end at the deck frame and the window edge), browser layout, hide the tree while decks are visible
* profiles: list (rename, apply, update, ↑ / ↓, ✕), save current view -> manual. `ui.layoutProfiles`, `ui.activeLayoutProfile`
* status bar: always / automatic / off, load meters DSP · latency · dropouts · memory · cpu (on) -> manual
* waveform style: 3-band blend (default) / spectrum (6 bands) / mono
* 3-band blend: preset (built in: A-K, 741 bone, orange, blue / white, classic; own ones below) with NEW / COPY / RENAME / DELETE / RESET. fields: crossovers low 40-400 Hz, mid 200-2000 Hz or auto (geometric mean), high 1-8 kHz (log sliders), attack / release per band, analysis weight per band, rgb direct or three colors, held highs / held lows color, level per band, high emphasis, energy share, transitions, stack curve, saturation, orange / light blue amount. changing a built-in preset creates an own copy (`<name> Kopie`) and selects it. `ui.wavePreset`, own presets in `wave-presets.json` (MINOS-741 folder) -> manual
* spectrum / mono: palette (not for spectrum): spectrum (rgb, default) / 741 bone / orange / blue / classic; high emphasis 0-3 (spectrum)
* zoom (seconds per side), minimum height (grows with the window), dim the played part
* beatgrid: on / off, colorful (phrases, bars, beats), phrase length 16 / 32 / 64 / 128 beats, bar numbers, magenta markers every 8 / 16 / 32 bars, lines fine (default) / bold (`ui.gridLineWeight`) -> manual
* cue colors (screen and controller pads): start cue red, cues white, loops green, short loops (up to 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 bars) magenta

## ◆ DECKS

* play: snap (cues, loops) and quant (jumps keep the phase), hotcue jump keeps the beat phase, load position (load cue / grid, track start or hotcue 1), track end warning (seconds, 0 = off), load lock while a deck plays
* tempo & sync: keylock on for the first load, default tempo range (±6 … ±100 %), phase lock while synced, sync mode (dynamic / fixed / tempo only), pitch bend amount, link offset (ms, ±50; constant shift to the peers after latency compensation, positive = the others play later)
* loops & beatjump: default loop size and beatjump size, loop snap (only with snap on) to loop cues (on, window 1-8 beats, default 4) and to the 4-bar grid (on, tolerance 1-8 beats, default 1), active loop every pass / once per load, auto loop on load (`engine.autoLoopBars`: 0 = off / 4 / 8 / 16 / 32 bars, default 16; only for tracks without a stored loop, not active)
* rows per deck (`ui.deckRows`), compact decks
* sizes: cover width 32-200 pt (`ui.deckCoverSize`, default 32), overview height 12-120 pt (`ui.overviewHeight`, default 18), all decks, scale with the zoom -> manual
* master clock & metronome: metronome output pair
* phrase anchor: off / suggest (default) / automatic -> on load the anchor is checked against the track's 8-bar structure, see manual 05
* edit mode & tool-loops: snap when marking (`ui.editSnap`: 1 beat / 1 bar / 2 / 4 / 8 bars, default 1 bar), load the cut result into the deck (`ui.cutLoadsResult`), tool-loops into folder … (`ui.toolLoopFolder`, empty = next to the original), prepare amp: allow clipping (`ui.prepAllowClipping`, off), prepare join: match tempo within ±0.5 % (`ui.prepJoinMatchTempo`, on) -> manual
* groove → midi (`groove`): midi source name (default `MINOS-741 Groove`), channel bass (1) / drums (10), bass octave 0-3 (C3 = 60, default 1), length without loop 1 / 2 bars (default 2), offset −100…100 ms. instrument and style of the deck row are saved here too

## ◆ MIXER & FX

* mixer: show internal mixer, auto-gain from the collection loudness, headroom internal (−3 dB default)
* mixer options: eq kill (knob fully left = off), crossfader curve (smooth / sharp cut), channel filter resonance
* external mixer: headroom, auto-gain, main volume also external
* fx units: show, 2 or 4 units, delay feedback and fx filter resonance (for slots without an own value, delay / roll filter), reverb type, reverb level (dB, 0 = reverb ~4 dB below the track at full d/w), reverb brightness (dark -> airy: high decay 35 … 90 %, low cut 150 … 400 Hz, high shelf −4 … +6 dB, default 0.6), reverb pre-delay (ms)
* fx mapping: per unit D/W, knob 1-3, button 1-3 -> any parameter of any slot (menu, search field above), all to default. same menu as the right click on the unit
* remembered mappings per rack (`engine.fxMappings`, key = effect names / plugin ids in slot order joined by ` > `; older `GROUP` keys are moved over on load), forget per entry. a unit keeps its own mapping in the session
* remembered racks (`engine.pluginChains`: name -> slots with effect or plugin id, on / off, d/w, parameters, plugin state), forget per entry. saved from the rack popover of a unit or the master bus

## ◆ PLUGINS

saved as json in `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/plugins.json`, not in the user defaults.

* load third-party plugins isolated (on): separate system service for audio units, apple plugins and VST3 always in-process
* folders: system and user audio unit folders + AUv3 + system and user VST3 folders (always), own folders (add / remove), install plugin … (`.component` and `.vst3`), rescan
* list with search: per plugin use in MINOS-741 (on / off), status, PRÜFEN (auval / VST3 self-check), click -> path, load default / isolated / in-process (audio units), `läuft im prozess` (VST3), unblock, last log
* ALLE PRÜFEN with progress and cancel, results kept per plugin + version
* crash marker `plugin-opening.json` next to it, a leftover marker blocks that plugin on the next start -> manual
* insert slots (up to 6 per fx unit and master bus) use the same list, isolation and crash handling per slot: a crashed or hanging slot is passed through, reloads after 2 s, blocked after 3 crashes
* architecture read from the bundle's binary: intel-only audio units load isolated only (badge `nur Intel – isoliert`), intel-only VST3 are listed but not loadable
* settings are read back with their validation results (iso 8601 dates); before, a file with a stored validation fell back to the defaults on the next start
* effect picker image without audio: `MIX741_SELFTEST=1 MIX741_SHOT=fx:<folder>` (top bar with 2 / 4 units, rack, picker, slot parameters)
* offscreen image of this tab without audio: `MIX741_SELFTEST=1 MIX741_SHOT=plugins:<folder>` (optional `MIX741_SHOT_PLUGINS=<plugin folder>`)

## ◆ BROWSER

* rows: padding around the text 3-16 pt, line between rows, height snaps to whole rows
* rows & fields: rows one line (default) / two lines (`ui.browserRows`), detail bar automatic (on with two lines, default) / on / off (`ui.detailBar`), short values (on, `ui.shortValues`), parts and order of the column `Track` (`ui.trackParts`, templates standard / comment first). panes override rows and detail bar from their header (session) -> manual
* played tracks: dim (on), hide (`ui.hidePlayedTracks`, off; also `UNGESPIELT` in the pane header, browser menu, assignable key `browser.hideplayed`), reset on start (off). hidden in collection, playlists, smartlists, music folders, search; not in history, running tracks, preparation (+ archive) -> manual
* history & preparation: played after x seconds audible (`engine.historyThreshold`), optional copy into the collection's history folder
* preview: start position of the browser preview (share of the track)
* harmony to the master: color the key column (on) -> manual
* ◆ PASST (matching): which steps count besides the same key: ±1 on the wheel (on), relative major / minor (on), energy ±2 (off). bpm window ±1-10 % (±4), half / double tempo (off). `ui.harmonyColors`, `ui.match`
* browser preview: full row, two lines (default) / own column / behind the title / off; colors spectrum red / green / blue (default) / like the waveform; compute in the background: always, throttled while a deck plays (default) / only while no deck plays / off -> manual
* cover: in the deck header (on, width: DECKS -> sizes), preview of the selected track below the browser tree (on). the browser column `Cover` is switched via right click on the list header
* collection: music folders for MUSIC FOLDERS (add / remove, empty = automatic: the folder holding 90 % of the collection's files); write browser edits into the collection file (off): backup at most once per hour into `Backup MINOS-741`, not while the library software runs -> manual
  * with it: cuts and tool loops as new entries (on), preparation + own history + own folders / playlists as playlists in `MINOS-741` (on)
* check collection: on start (off), scan the music folders for files without a collection entry (on) -> manual
* analyse: bpm range (one octave, default 100-200), learn / discard key profiles, rip check with every analysis (`ui.ripWithAnalysis`, on), mark a rip finding as range on load (`ui.ripMarkOnLoad`, on) -> manual
* DAW bridge: receive warp markers and position from the DAW's remote script (on), udp port 7411 (127.0.0.1 only). `ui.dawBridge`, `ui.dawBridgePort` -> manual

## ◆ TAGS

* separator for comment 2 (`ui.tagSeparators`, empty = space), color tags (`ui.tagHighlight`)
* tag colors: every tag of the collection by count (filter, first 300), color per tag (`ui.tagColors`), ↺ = default color

## ◆ CLOUD

library in a cloud folder -> library · cloud libraries

* state: local · online only · missing, time and duration of the last check, CHECK NOW
* keep local while MINOS-741 runs: off / preparation + open playlists + decks (default) / whole library. open playlists = playlists and smartlists in the browser panes up to 1000 tracks
* parallel downloads 1-4 (2), keep at least 5 / 10 / 20 / 50 gb free (10)
* on quit hand open downloads to the provider (on)
* library folder, available offline (pinned / not / unknown, all local), SHOW IN FINDER, CHECK. pinning is done in the finder: right click -> make available offline

## ◆ KEYBOARD

* every app shortcut, grouped: decks, browser, view, general -> table in MANUAL · keys
* click a shortcut, press the new key -> applies right away, esc = cancel
* ✕ = no shortcut, ↺ = back to default, RESET ALL
* a key used twice turns red, the first action in the list wins
* ⌘Q, ⌘H, ⌘M, ⌃⌘F stay with the system
* saved under `shortcuts` (action id -> key, e.g. `"browser.resetplayed": "opt+cmd+p"`), only keys that differ from the default

## ◆ CONTROLLER

* controllers: name, serial number, side (left a / c, right b / d, saved per device, swaps the other unit), decks per unit (left / right), browser pane and fx unit per unit, blink to identify, startup show per device
* cue action: flux reverse / cue / reverse
* flux button: switch pad layer (hotcues 5-8, default; shift + flux = flux mode) / flux mode (tap toggles flux mode if enabled)
* flux held + pads: hotcues 5-8 or beatjump on pads 3 / 4, beatjump size for flux + hotcue 3 / 4
* touch strip: bend or seek, sensitivity
* browse step with shift, shift + LOAD, browse push: big browser (default) / matching on / off
* leds: brightness on / off, startup show on connect (on). pad colors = cue colors under DISPLAY

# LIBRARY

## ◆ DUAL BROWSER

* one, two side by side or two stacked browser panes (toolbar)
* every pane has its own tree selection, search, sort (up to three columns, header click stacks them), role filter and tags
* stacked: the pane header (title, search, roles, tags) is a column left of the list, the pane height goes to rows
* rows one or two lines per pane (`≡` / `☰` in the header): two lines put title · artist on top and comment · tags · label below in one column `Track`; detail bar below the list (`▭`) with all fields of the selected track -> manual
* left controller drives the left pane, right controller the right one
* space / browse push = big browser
* split line between decks and browser can be dragged

## ◆ FAVORITES

* 6 slots per pane, above the tree and the list header
* slot = source (track collection, preparation, running tracks, history, playlist, smartlist, playlist folder, own playlist / smartlist / folder, music folder) or filter (tags, excluded tags, roles, search)
* click -> source of the pane / filter applied, active filter again -> cleared. red = active
* right click -> `Aktuelle Quelle hier ablegen` · `Aktuellen Filter hier ablegen` · `Umbenennen …` · `Leeren`
* drag a tree entry onto a slot
* ⌃⌥1-6 -> last used pane
* saved per pane in the session. playlists + smartlists by collection uuid, then path · own entries by id, then name · music folders by path
* target gone after a reload -> slot grey, struck through

## ◆ MUSIC FOLDERS

* tree node MUSIC FOLDERS -> the music library as folders on disk
* click a folder -> its audio files, SUBFOLDERS -> everything below it
* files in the collection: all columns (bpm, key, comment 2 / tags, plays …), matched by path
* files not in the collection: grey, title from the file name (`artist - title`), no grid. load, preview, preparation work anyway
* folders are read in the background when they open, then cached. right click -> rescan
* default folder: deepest folder that holds 90 % of the collection's existing files, e.g. `~/Music/DJ`
* own folders: ⌘, -> BROWSER -> collection -> add folder (the automatic one stays in the list)
* every pane keeps its own folder and the subfolders switch, saved in the session
## ◆ CHECK THE COLLECTION

* BROWSER menu -> `Collection prüfen …` or right click TRACK COLLECTION
* read only: files (missing, permissions, 0 bytes), audio header, duration vs the collection (> 2 s), spelling on disk (case, nfc / nfd), title / artist vs file name, duplicates (same file, same artist + title), analysis (bpm, grid, key, loudness), grid (bpm 60-200, anchor inside the file), playlist entries without a track, files in the music folders without a collection entry
* installer style: progress, current file, log, counters. ABBRECHEN stops at once and keeps the findings
* findings table: filter per check, show in browser / finder, copy path, report as txt or csv
* details: manual

## ◆ ANALYSIS

* right click tracks, a playlist, smartlist, playlist folder, music folder, PREPARATION or TRACK COLLECTION -> `Analysieren` (missing values only) or `Neu analysieren` (everything; tracks locked in the collection: missing values only)
* tempo + grid anchor, key (open key like the collection), loudness (auto-gain). own code, offline, deterministic, accelerate only
* same queue and rules as the previews: 2 files at a time, throttled while a deck plays, pauses while a deck loads, status bar `Analyse 12/240 · gedrosselt`, ✕ = cancel
* results in `analysis.json` (MINOS-741 folder), laid over the collection on every load -> list, columns, sorting, smartlists, deck, sync, key readout. purple ✓ = own values. right click -> `Analyse verwerfen`
* files from MUSIC FOLDERS without a collection entry get tempo, grid, key and loudness too -> sync works
* collection file only with `Änderungen in die Collection-Datei schreiben` (⌘, -> BROWSER -> collection): TEMPO, LOUDNESS, MUSICAL_KEY and the grid marker (CUE_V2 TYPE 4) of the analyzed entries, same backup and byte-exact write as the metadata edits
* `Neu analysieren` drops an own grid edit (bpm / anchor) of the track, hotcues stay. a track on a deck keeps its grid until the next load
* phrase suggestions: the grid anchor stays on beat 1. the analysis also stores the phrase start (bar 1 of a 4 / 8 / 16 / 32 bar phrase) with a confidence 0–1 and shows it as a suggestion (red phrase button in the grid row). setting `Automatisch übernehmen ab` (⌘, -> DECKS -> phrase anchor, default 0.70): at or above it the mode `Automatisch` moves the anchor, below it only suggests. own grid edits are never overwritten
* method: ~11 kHz mono · spectral flux -> fourier tempogram with harmonic comb (60–200 bpm) -> fine search at the beat frequency -> whole beats between start and end · anchor from the onset envelope folded on the beat (1 ms), phrase start by the phrase anchor logic · chroma against krumhansl / temperley profiles · gated block loudness, `PERCEIVED_DB` = gain to the collection's reference
* 20 tracks of the collection (local files): bpm 18 / 20 within 0.1 (the other two 0.7–1.0 off, old vinyl tracks), key 6 / 20 exact + 2 related, loudness ±1.3 dB (median deviation from the collection's value), grid within 20 ms of the collection's marker 10 / 18, ~1 s per track
* details: manual

## ◆ SOUND FEATURES

* after each analysis (setting `Klangmerkmale bei der Analyse mit`, default on) and via `queueFeatures` for tracks without an entry: kick pitch and decay, drum grid (kick, clap, hats, bass; 16 steps, share of bars), clap placement and timbre consistency, hat division and swing, rumble, mid rhythm
* local files only (cloud placeholders are not read), background queue, `Klangmerkmale gleichzeitig` = 1 by default (max 4)
* results in `features.json` (MINOS-741 folder), keyed like `analysis.json`; entries of another version are dropped
* method: own spectrum (`SpectrumAnalyzer`) and tempo/anchor from the analysis · kick pitch from zero crossings of the low signal (300 Hz low pass, ~2.2 kHz), decay to 10 % amplitude · grid over up to 96 bars (kick and hats via groove extraction, others by onset rise) · embedding of 95 values in 0…1, distance = euclidean
* thresholds: `FeatureThresholds` (kick low ≤ 65 Hz, long ≥ 250 ms, short ≤ 120 ms, rumble ≥ 0.5, swing ≥ 0.15, consistent clap ≥ 0.9, step on ≥ 40 % of bars, row empty < 15 %)

## ◆ RIP CHECK

* right click tracks or a source -> `Rip prüfen`, or with every analysis (⌘, -> BROWSER -> analyse, on)
* start and end: silence (start > 2 s, end > 6 s), rest of the previous track / start of the next one (key change or other tempo, hard cut, 4 / 8 bar loop hint), grid suspect at the start. breakdown and drum intros are no finding
* `ripcheck.json` (MINOS-741 folder). column `Rip` (`▸ 7,3 s`, `◂ 3:02`, `GRID`), `◆ RIP` filter, tree `ZU BEARBEITEN`
* nothing is cut automatically: loading a track pre-marks the proposed part as a marked range (`RIP · …`, ⌘, -> BROWSER -> analyse -> `Rip-Befund beim Laden markieren`, on). right click in the range -> `Markierten Bereich entfernen` (edit list) or `… (neue Datei)`
* other actions: set cut IN / OUT (edits.json, no new file), remove the region as a new file, discard. done when the side has a cut or after an action on the RIP range. deck: `RIP` in edit and prepare row marks the range, striped region in the overview
* details: manual

## ◆ RELOAD

* ↻ / ⌘O: everything heavy runs in the background (parse, file check, own edits, indices, sorting of the lists both panes show), the main thread only takes the result
* unchanged tracks and playlists keep their identity -> the lists do not rebuild when nothing changed
* 14,160 tracks, two panes: longest ui stall 1.3 s -> under 30 ms (unchanged collection), 1.5 -> 0.3 s with changed entries

## ◆ CLOUD LIBRARIES

library in a cloud folder (google drive for desktop, icloud drive, any file provider under `~/Library/CloudStorage`):

* column ☁: ● local · ☁ online only · ↓ downloading (grey = waiting) · ✕ missing · empty = not in a cloud folder
* check = file status only (`SF_DATALESS`), nothing gets downloaded. 14k tracks ~0.1 s. on load, on changes in the folder, every 10 min
* ● LOKAL in the pane header -> local tracks only
* right click tracks, a playlist, smartlist, playlist folder, PREPARATION or TRACK COLLECTION -> `Bereitmachen (herunterladen)`
* SET-CHECK in the pane header -> preparation + the pane's list, everything not local listed, `ALLE HOLEN` fetches it
* keep local while MINOS-741 runs: off / preparation + open playlists + decks (default) / whole library. evicted tracks are fetched again
* 2 downloads at a time, new ones wait while a deck loads, keep local goes last and one at a time, 3 tries, 10 gb stay free
* online-only track into a deck -> download requested at once, status bar message
* quit with open downloads -> handed to the provider, it finishes them without MINOS-741
* always offline: finder -> right click the library folder -> make available offline. ⌘, -> CLOUD shows whether it is set

## ◆ EDIT TRACKS

* inline: click a selected row again or return, tab = next column, esc = cancel
* edit window: right click -> `Bearbeiten …` or ⌘E, also for several tracks at once
* saved in MINOS-741 first, optional write-back into the collection file with backup
* details: manual, nml files

## ◆ SAVE TO FILE

* core: `FileTagWriter` (MixMedia). MP3, AIFF, WAV, FLAC, M4A (AAC, ALAC)
* MP3/AIFF/WAV: BPM (TBPM), key (TKEY), comment (COMM), comment 2 (TXXX `COMMENT2`), rating (POPM), MINOS block (PRIV, owner `MINOS-741`)
* FLAC: Vorbis comments BPM, INITIALKEY, COMMENT, COMMENT2 (custom key), RATING (1–5); MINOS block as Vorbis key `MINOS741` (base64 of the JSON). Region = metadata blocks; PADDING absorbs growth, otherwise the region is rebuilt. STREAMINFO, PICTURE, SEEKTABLE, CUESHEET stay byte for byte
* M4A: moov/udta/meta/ilst: `tmpo` (BPM, whole number), `©cmt` (comment), `----` mean `com.apple.iTunes` for INITIALKEY, COMMENT2, RATING (1–5), MINOS741 (base64). Region = moov; chunk offsets behind a grown moov are moved; mdat is hashed
* the JSON block is `v`=1: grid, cues, features
* audio payload is hashed before and after; only the tag region changes; temp file in the same folder, re-read and verified, then replaced
* the previous tag bytes go to `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/tag-backups/<key hash>/`; `undo` restores them byte for byte (refused if the audio changed)
* foreign frames stay; a field without a value leaves the file as it is
* not yet: context menu, settings, auto-save, network throttle, read-back on import

## ◆ SEARCH

plain words (as before): every word is a substring, case and accents ignored, all words must match, searched in the fields chosen in the search menu (`ALL` or ARTIST, TITLE, COMMENT, COMMENT 2, LABEL, GENRE, ALBUM, KEY, LOOP).

field terms (searched in all fields of the track, not the menu fields):

```
tag:og3                exact tag of comment 2
folder:techno          directory path contains (dir: is the same)
playlist:warm          track in an own playlist whose name contains "warm"
artist:klock title:sub label:x genre:x key:8a   substring
bpm:120-128  bpm>124  bpm<=130  bpm:124   numbers, rounded as shown
rating>=3  plays>0  year:2024            numbers: bpm rating plays year
kick:low|high|long|short  kick:<60  kick:>=50   kick pitch in Hz (sound features)
clap:2-4|every|off|same                         clap placement; same = steady timbre
hats:16|8|off|swing                             hat division (8 = eighths or offbeat eighths)
rumble:yes|no  rumble:>0.5                      sustained low tone between the kicks
```

* `-tag:x` or `!tag:x` negates a term
* `tag:og3,og4` = either value (OR inside one field); terms are AND
* `tag:"deep house"` for values with spaces (tags with a separator other than space)
* sound feature terms (kick, clap, hats, rumble) need features for the track; a track without them never matches. German values: tief, hoch, lang, kurz, gleich, ja, nein
* a term that does not parse, or an unknown name, is a plain word
* German names: `ordner` = folder, `liste` = playlist, `tonart` = key (⌘, -> BROWSER -> Suche; more pairs `word=field` there)
* the recognized terms show as a short line next to the field (⌘, -> BROWSER -> Suche)
* smartlists are not searched by `playlist:`

## ◆ ROLE CHIPS

basis · synth · drums · voll · atmo
* filter on the role at the end of comment 2 (`» BASIS` etc.)
* more than one chip = any of them

## ◆ TAGS ON COMMENT 2

comment 2 gets split into tags at a separator:
* default separator is a space
* every character in the setting splits, e.g. `·` or `·»`

example with `·`:

```
K tief kurz · B sub leicht roll · H off » BASIS
-> "K tief kurz", "B sub leicht roll", "H off » BASIS"
```

* "tags ▾" lists all tags of the source with counts
* click = filter, several tags = all must match
* ⌥-click = exclude, none of the excluded tags may be there
* comment 2 column shows the tags as chips -> click / ⌥-click works there too
* whole tags only, case and accents ignored
* active filter in the pane header, ✕ TAGS clears it, kept in the session

## ◆ SMARTLISTS

* all smartlists from the collection work as they are
* own smartlists, playlists and folders in one tree PLAYLISTS, folders in folders -> manual · playlists
* smartlist editor: rows `field | operator | value`, all / any, sort + limit, live count, values from the collection or typed (kept as own values) -> manual
* the query text stays available as the row `Ausdruck`

```
$COMMENT2 % "BASIS" & $BPM >= 128 & $IMPORTDATE >= MONTHS_AGO(6)
```

syntax: nml files.

## ◆ PREPARATION

* right click a track -> "an preparation anhängen"
* archived and cleared on every start
* archive = playlist nml (`TYPE="LIST"`) in `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/Preparation`

## ◆ RUNNING TRACKS · PLAYED

* RUNNING TRACKS = the tracks loaded on the decks
* column ▶: ✓ = played (same rule as history), stays until right click TRACK COLLECTION -> Reset Played State
* `UNGESPIELT` in the pane header (or ⌘, -> BROWSER -> played tracks): played tracks hidden everywhere except history, running tracks and preparation
* the thin stripe in front = track color from the collection

## ◆ HISTORY

* a track counts as played after 30s audible (setting: ⌘, -> BROWSER -> history & preparation)
* external mixer mode: always audible, the desk decides
* internal mode: only with fader / crossfader open
* written as history nml (`history_2026-10-10-01.nml`, day + session number) with deck, start time and play duration; quitting asks first and writes everything
* saved in `~/Library/Application Support/MINOS-741/History`, optional copy into the collection's history folder
* "history" = current session, "history archiv" = own sessions plus all sessions found in that folder
